shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo "-----" && ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null && echo "-----" && cat AGENTS.md && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -100

sed -n 1,80p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && echo "----- table entry" && rg -n -C 6 -i 'gravity-ui/table|data grid|DataTable' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -120 && echo "----- src" && cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts && echo "----- traps" && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && echo "----- installed" && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | rg '"version"' && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head

.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Table withTableSorting withTableSelection Pagination 2>&1 | head -80; echo "----- docs dirs"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/ ; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist/docs 2>&1 | head; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -name 'README.md' | head

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; echo "== Table.d.ts"; cat $U/Table/Table.d.ts; echo "== withTableSorting"; cat $U/Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.d.ts; echo "== withTableSelection"; cat $U/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.d.ts; echo "== Pagination"; cat $U/Pagination/Pagination.d.ts $U/Pagination/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo "== Table index"; cat $U/Table/index.d.ts

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; echo "== sorting impl meta"; rg -n 'meta|defaultSortOrder|disableDataSorting' $U/Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.js | head -30; echo "== selection impl"; rg -n 'meta|getRowDescriptor|disabled|getRowId' $U/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.js | head -20; echo "== online docs (major 7)"; curl -sS -m 20 -o /tmp/uikit7.txt -w 'HTTP %{http_code} bytes %{size_download}\n' https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt; rg -n -i -C 3 'withTableSorting|withTableSelection' /tmp/uikit7.txt | head -80

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; sed -n 30,75p $U/Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.js; echo "== getRowId"; rg -n -A 12 'static getRowId' $U/Table/Table.js; echo "== exports check"; rg -n -o 'Label|Flex|Text|Button|Card|Checkbox|Pagination|Table' $U/index.d.ts | sort -u | head -20; echo "== Label view"; rg -n 'theme\?:' $U/Label/Label.d.ts

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; sed -n 84,112p $U/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.js; echo "== hoc index"; cat $U/Table/hoc/index.d.ts; echo "== Flex/Text/Label quick"; rg -n 'direction\?|gap\?' $U/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head -4; rg -n "variant\?|color\?" $U/Text/Text.d.ts $U/Text/text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -4; rg -n "size\?" $U/Label/Label.d.ts | head -2
npx vite build 2>&1 | tail -15; echo "build exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; git status --short
